expression: 0.200 * group_rank(ts_rank(actual_sales_value_quarterly / sales_estimate_average_quarterly, 126), industry) + 0.160 * group_rank(ts_rank((call_breakeven_60 - put_breakeven_60) / close, 60), industry) + 0.110 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (implied_volatility_mean_60 - historical_volatility_60), 60), industry) + 0.130 * group_rank(ts_rank(pcr_oi_all, 60), industry) + 0.120 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.090 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * rel_ret_comp, 20), industry) + 0.090 * group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / equity, 126), subindustry) + 0.060 * group_rank(ts_rank(cashflow_op / assets, 126), subindustry) - 0.040 * group_rank(ts_rank(pv13_ompetitorgraphrank_hub_rank, 60), industry)
